paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.03% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.84%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-0.55%). Brent crude changed +0.55% to 106.27. Gold changed +0.27% to 4,188.5. Bitcoin changed +2.34% to 83,678.3203. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.217%, a relative move of -0.44%. Among the firms tracked, Citigroup (-5.60%) and KKR (-4.75%) moved the most.
